name: sync-instructions
description: Syncs Kiro agent prompts, steering, and skills to all external AI CLI formats — AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules, .cursor/rules/, .github/copilot-instructions.md, and .opencode/agent/
welcomeMessage:
Sync Instructions ready.

I'll read every .kiro source file (prompts, agents, steering, skills) and update all external instruction files to match:

  → AGENTS.md
  → CLAUDE.md
  → GEMINI.md
  → .cursorrules
  → .cursor/rules/morphe.mdc
  → .github/copilot-instructions.md
  → .opencode/agent/*.md (6 agents)

Just say: "sync" or "update all" and I'll do the rest.
Want to check what's changed first? Say: "diff" or "what's out of date?"
